2026-06-05: Folder selection state is URL-driven via useFolderSelection() hook. URL contract: ?folder=all|notable|unfiled|category:<key>|<cuid> and ?view=templates. Setter uses router.push (back/forward navigates folders). Any new caller mutating folder selection must go through this hook — do not add useState<FolderSelection> back into worklog-page.tsx.

2026-06-05: Open follow-up sprint — 'worklog-as-landing-page' redesign. /worklog would become a curated home (quick-capture hero, today's notes, stat cards, folder grid, recent list) with the existing 2-pane list+reader relocated to /worklog/notes. Three open questions: (1) Today section card vs one-liner, (2) routing /worklog/notes vs ?view=notes, (3) Quick Capture inline-save vs escalate-to-editor.

New (app)/worklog/layout.tsx mounts <FullBleedShell> once for both. Sidebar override (ADR-0013) gates on pathname.startsWith('/worklog') so it covers both routes unchanged.

2026-06-06: WorklogHomeView composes 5 section components in src/components/worklog/home/: worklog-quick-capture (hero, escalates via router.push to /worklog/notes?focus=<id>), worklog-today-list (one-liner today notes), worklog-stat-cards (streak sparkline / month / notable), worklog-folder-grid (top 8 by recent activity + Templates tile), worklog-recent-list (earlier-this-week one-liners). 2026-06-06: <WorklogActivityWidget> REMOVED from /worklog/notes. Lives only on /worklog home now. Worklog-page.tsx no longer imports it.

2026-06-06: WorklogNavSidebar now has a 'Home' row (<Link href='/worklog'>, active when pathname === '/worklog'). Filter rows (All notes / Notable / Templates / folders / categories) navigate cross-route to /worklog/notes when clicked from /worklog; when already on /worklog/notes they mutate URL params via useFolderSelection setter. Filter active state suppressed on /worklog (the home page does not represent a filter).

2026-06-06: New helper exported from use-folder-selection.ts: selectionToQueryString(selection) builds the query-string for a target FolderSelection without binding to current pathname — used for cross-route navigation from the worklog home into /worklog/notes.

2026-06-07: New components: <WorklogNoteReadView> (pure read-only renderer, no editor mount, used by both drawer and full-screen route) and <WorklogReaderDrawer> (drawer chrome, owns open/close lifecycle).

[2026-06-09 lesson] Recurring miss when wiring a new mention entity type: forgetting that the canonical record has a primary display field (title/name/company) and instead deriving the chip label from a secondary projection. [2026-06-09] Test counts post-fix: 364/364 pass (was 343 pre-fix). Added 10 helper tests + 8 mutator tests + 3 mention-search tests.

[2026-06-09 trap] `${pathname}?focus=<id>` is unsafe when pathname can be either /worklog/notes (list view, ?focus= drives the drawer) OR /worklog/notes/<currentId> (dedicated reader, only the path id is consumed). On the dedicated reader the appended ?focus= is silently ignored — clicks looked dead. Canonical builder is buildWorklogFocusHref(pathname, entityId) at src/lib/worklog/focus-href.ts: list → ?focus=, reader → swap path id, anywhere else → list+?focus=. Three callsites consume it (mention-node-view, worklog-backlinks-panel, worklog-note-view). Any new surface that pivots between worklog notes from a chip/backlink MUST use the helper, not pathname concat.

[2026-06-09 trap] Tiptap 3 StarterKit ships Link as a built-in extension. Importing @tiptap/extension-link and calling Link.configure(...) elsewhere in the same editor triggers `Duplicate extension names found: ['link']`. Disable via StarterKit.configure({ link: false }) at every callsite that registers a custom Link config — applies to worklog-editor.tsx (SCHEMA_EXTENSIONS + useEditor) and rich-text-editor.tsx. Same pattern would apply to any other StarterKit-included extension we override (heading, history, etc.).

[2026-06-09] WorklogBacklinksPanel already renders in BOTH read and edit modes on /worklog/notes/[id] — it lives outside the editMode ternary in worklog-note-reader.tsx. [2026-06-09 trap] Next.js 16 / React 19 BLOCKS window.prompt() / window.confirm() in dev mode — throws 'Error: prompt() is not supported.' Don't even try prompt/confirm/alert in any new client component — go straight to Dialog. Also captured in user memory.

2026-06-09: Y.js sync after restore is PARKED. POST .../restore overwrites server-side contentJson + content but doesn't broadcast a Y.update to open editor sessions. The device that triggered restore sees the new state via query invalidation; OTHER open devices keep their stale Y.Doc until next reload. Data is correct on next load. Future work would broadcast a Y.update via the collaboration backend.

New tests: grouping.test.ts (8), diff.test.ts (9), versions/route.test.ts (20), versions/[versionId]/route.test.ts (5), restore route, plus auto-snapshot + retention tests in PUT route.test.ts (~18). Per-worklog GET /api/work-logs/[id]/export, bulk POST /api/work-logs/export-bulk (N=1 .md, N>1 .zip via JSZip, hard cap 100), re-import POST /api/work-logs/import-md.

[2026-06-09] Re-import routes via pure decideImport(input) -> 4-case ImportDecision union {match | conflict | needs-picker | not-found} in src/lib/worklog/import/grill-frontmatter.ts. [2026-06-09] WorkLog has NO integer version column — versions are append-only WorkLogVersion rows. Frontmatter `version` is populated from `prisma.workLogVersion.count(...)` on export and compared on re-import via `decideImport`. Conflict surfaces when fileVersion < currentVersion; match covers fileVersion >= currentVersion (file-ahead is safe because every match auto-snapshots first).

[2026-06-09] Custom Tiptap nodes (mention, tag, shiftBlock, moodBlock, photo, canvasBlock) are NOT in prosemirror-markdown's defaultMarkdownSerializer. We wrote a direct JSON walker (src/lib/worklog/export/pm-to-markdown.ts) that handles each by name. canvasBlock is dropped on export (placeholder line + droppedBlocks counter); mentions emit as `@<prefix>:<entityId>` and are re-resolved on re-import. MENTION_PREFIX = {asset:'a', skill:'s', company:'c', contact:'p', worklog:'n'}.

[2026-06-09] UI integration: Export button lives in WorklogNotesBulkBar (between Move and Delete), wired in worklog-notes-view.tsx -> exportBulkWorklogs(ids) from src/lib/worklog/export/client.ts. Re-import auto-detects via WorklogImportDialog's hasGrillFrontmatter(source) regex — `---` fence + `id:` + `version:` keys — and routes to /api/work-logs/import-md. Four new row statuses (reimported / conflict / needs-picker / not-found) map to the four decideImport outcomes.

[2026-06-09] Web Share onramp (ADR-0022 addendum) — bulk-bar Export button became a Send DropdownMenu with two destinations: Download (always) + Share to… (Web Share API Level 2). Both reuse POST /api/work-logs/export-bulk so the artifact is identical. canShareFiles() in src/lib/worklog/share/can-share.ts is SSR-safe (probes `navigator.canShare({files:[<probe File>]})`); on unsupported browsers (Firefox desktop, SSR, insecure contexts) shareWorklogs() falls back to the synthetic-download path and surfaces sonner toast 'Sharing isn't supported on this browser. The file was downloaded instead.' decideShareOutcome() returns 'shared' (error===null) | 'cancelled' (AbortError, both DOMException + plain Error variants) | 'downloaded' (any other failure → fallback fired). Share menu ITEM is rendered unconditionally; capability gate happens at click-time inside shareWorklogs. Per-row Send menu and standalone top-level picker dialog parked with re-entry criteria; bulk streaming/progress NOT parked (markdown is small, YAGNI). Test count 542 → 554 (+12: 6 canShareFiles, 6 decideShareOutcome). Google Drive integration is now SUPERSEDED by this onramp.

[2026-06-10] ADR-0022 Addendum 2 — top-level Export menu shipped next to Import. Bulk-bar dropdown extracted into shared <WorklogSendMenu> at src/components/worklog/worklog-send-menu.tsx; mounted twice with different scopes — toolbar copy acts on visibleLogs (current view) with triggerLabel='Export', bulk-bar copy acts on selectedIdList with triggerLabel='Send'. Shared runDownload(ids)/runShare(ids) handlers in worklog-notes-view.tsx so the export-in-flight gate (exportBusy) and sonner toast pattern stay unified. Client-side EXPORT_MAX_VIEW=100 mirrors server BULK_MAX with honest toast 'Too many notes in this view (N). Narrow your filter or use Select mode to pick up to 100.' — fired before any network call. Both surfaces coexist when bulk-mode is active (Architectural Reviewer Option A) so the user keeps the 'export current view' path even with a selection. Trigger: user feedback that desktop Chrome / Windows OS share sheet doesn't include Drive, leaving Web Share's promise empty on that platform; toolbar Export gives the export pipeline a discoverable home without first entering Select mode. Drive integration deferred to ADR-0023 next session (Gmail OAuth client already in .env, EmailAccount table already stores accessToken+refreshToken — cost dropped from ~1 week to ~4-6 hours).

Sidebar gains an Archived row below Templates. 6-unit ship: 96d7b2a (schema+types), 30cebcf (API+TDD), eaa8458 (list+search+TDD), e20e0f2 (sidebar row + bucket toggle), 61934ec (action surfaces), Unit 6 = this commit (ADR + Manual + memory + handoff).
